hero.title: A Simple Stay in Thamel. A Better Night's Sleep.
hero.subtitle: No Restaurant. No Noise. Sleep Well.
hero.paragraph: Welcome to Hotel Sherpa Soul, a small and comfortable hotel in the heart of Thamel, Kathmandu. We keep things simple: comfortable rooms, a peaceful place to rest, practical facilities, friendly service and a convenient location for exploring Kathmandu.

aboutVision.title: Philosophy: No Restaurant. No Noise. Sleep Well.
aboutVision.part1: We intentionally keep the hotel simple and peaceful. Instead of running a busy restaurant or entertainment space, our focus is entirely on
aboutVision.para2: Hotel Sherpa Soul is built around a simple understanding of hospitality: travellers need a place where they feel comfortable, welcome and able to rest after walking Kathmandu's vibrant streets or returning from a Himalayan trek.
aboutVision.para3: What we offer is simpler and more meaningful: a comfortable room, a convenient location in Thamel, a quiet night's sleep, and genuine Sherpa warmth welcoming you to Nepal.

rooms.name: Budget Family Room
rooms.description: A comfortable, budget-friendly family room designed for families, small groups, or trekkers resting before and after Himalayan trails. Features one King size bed and one Single bed, accommodating up to 3 adults and 1 child. Includes private attached bathroom with 24/7 hot water, bright natural light, clean linen, and shared self-kitchen privileges.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: A serene and comfortable deluxe room featuring a restful King size bed accommodating up to 2 adults and 1 child. Perfect for couples, solo travelers, or digital nomads seeking quiet, peaceful sleep in the heart of Thamel. Equipped with individual climate control (air conditioning), private modern ensuite bathroom with 24/7 hot shower, work desk, and shared guest kitchen access.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: Spacious and peaceful family accommodation designed for 3 adults and 1 child. Equipped with air conditioning (AC), one King size bed and one Single bed with comfortable mattresses, ample space for luggage, private attached bathroom with continuous hot water shower, and access to our shared self-kitchen.
